group: canShortCircuit - initial evaluation, no blocking keywords

cases.description: When `canShortCircuit` field is null and the parent schema's validators list does not contain any validator whose keyword is "unevaluatedProperties" or "unevaluatedItems", the method should compute `true` and store it.
When `canShortCircuit` field is null and at least one validator in the parent schema returns the keyword "unevaluatedProperties", the method must set `canShortCircuit` to false and return false.
When `canShortCircuit` field is null and at least one validator in the parent schema returns the keyword "unevaluatedItems", the method must set `canShortCircuit` to false and return false.
If `canShortCircuit` field has already been set to `true` (by a previous call), the method should return the cached value without iterating over validators.
If `canShortCircuit` field has already been set to `false` (by a previous call), the method should return the cached value without iterating over validators.

group: canShortCircuit - initial evaluation, mixed validators including blocking keyword

cases.description: When `canShortCircuit` is null and the parent schema contains several validators, some of which have the keywords "unevaluatedProperties" or "unevaluatedItems" among other non‑blocking validators, the method must detect the blocking keyword and set `canShortCircuit` to false.

group: canShortCircuit - initial evaluation, multiple non‑blocking validators

cases.description: When `canShortCircuit` is null and the parent schema contains multiple validators but none of them return the keywords "unevaluatedProperties" or "unevaluatedItems", the method should compute and cache `true`.

group: canShortCircuit - initial evaluation, validator with null keyword

cases.description: When a validator in the parent schema returns `null` (or an empty string) for `getKeyword()`, it must be ignored as a non‑blocking keyword, resulting in `canShortCircuit` being true.

group: canShortCircuit - cached true persists after parent schema changes

cases.description: After the first call computes `true` and caches it, modify the parent schema to add a validator with a blocking keyword. A subsequent call must return the cached `true` without re‑evaluating the updated validators list.

group: canShortCircuit - cached false persists after parent schema changes

cases.description: After the first call computes `false` (because a blocking keyword was present) and caches it, change the parent schema to remove the blocking validator. A later call must still return the cached `false`.
When `getEvaluationParentSchema()` returns null, the method attempts to call `getValidators()` on a null reference, causing a NullPointerException.
When the parent schema exists but its `getValidators()` method returns null, iterating over a null collection triggers a NullPointerException.
When the validators list contains a `null` element, the loop attempts to invoke `validator.getKeyword()` on a null reference, resulting in a NullPointerException.
If a validator's `getKeyword()` implementation throws a RuntimeException (e.g., due to internal errors), the method propagates that exception without handling it.
